resources.string: Menu or race?\nWith separate layouts enabled, one ☰ button switches between them: the menu layout gives a four-way D-pad with ✓ and ←, the race layout gives left / right buttons and pedals. It never switches by itself. With one shared layout every button stays visible: gas / brake also navigate up / down, and ✓ / ← work in menus.

How does the mouse work?\nSlide on empty screen space to move the cursor. Lift after a slide without clicking. A short stationary tap clicks at the cursor position. Hold still to press and keep the button, then drag; lift to release. Multi-finger gestures do not click.

What does size change?\nGlobal size scales the default controls. In Edit positions & touch zones, drag a control and adjust Button to change its appearance, or Touch zone to change only where it responds. Dashed outlines show the touch zones; percentages are relative to the default control. Changes save automatically.

One layout or two?\nWith Separate menu and race layouts off, the same controls, positions and sizes are used in menus and races. Turn it on to customise each mode independently. Switching this option keeps both sets of saved layouts. Reset layout restores the selected set only. Steering on left / right mirrors both default and manually saved positions.

Edges and vertical position\nDistance from edges moves default controls inward. Raise driving controls moves the default lower controls upward. System cutouts are respected. Manually placed controls keep their saved positions.

Opacity and auto-hide\nOpacity sets normal visibility. Auto-hide starts after all fingers lift, after a delay of 1–30 seconds. Choose a faint silhouette or complete invisibility. Hidden buttons still respond on the first touch and become visible again. Holding a control prevents hiding.

Manual gears\nShow gear − / + adds two optional buttons to the race layout. Enable manual transmission in the game. Their keyboard assignments are available in Controls mapping and must match the game settings.

Vibration\nEnable Phone vibration in Touch controls or Gamepad vibration in Controls mapping, then restart the game. Effects come from the game Force Feedback system, never from button taps. Enable Force Feedback in the game as well. The last-used input selects the output. Controller vibration requires Android driver support; a controller can work for input without exposing vibration. Directional wheel forces are converted to rumble intensity.

Controller assignments\nTap a button, trigger or stick direction on the Player 1 controller diagram to choose its action. The list below also lets you choose the physical input and the keyboard key sent to the game. Assigning an occupied input replaces its previous action. Restart the game after changing mappings.
Lights and recovery\n☼ sends L. ↻ sends R to return to the track. These assignments can be changed in Controls mapping.

Screen and game data\nLandscape locks the game horizontally; Auto permits rotation. FPS cap limits frame rate; a lower value can reduce work per second. Game data manages imports and shows which data set is active. Play is enabled when a data set is ready.
